english_local_transition.finding: The English has a direct local transition from the end of the Ata/Abu Lahab report to the al-Suddi marker, separated only by one space. It contains no translation of the intervening Arabic Ibn Abbas/Abu Jahl attribution or adjacent enemy gloss.
english_local_transition.scope_limit: This proves a local omission only. It does not establish global absence of Ibn Abbas, Abu Jahl, or an enemy gloss elsewhere in the English witness, and it does not authorize an invented English sentence.
